name: alice
description: ALICE helps Soundscape creators explore account, organization, and real-time analytics data and understand public workflows. Currently in invitation-only testing.

interface.longDescription: ALICE currently offers account and organization lookup, real-time analytics queries, and guidance on public workflows. ALICE is currently in invitation-only testing: anyone can install the plugin, but accounts that haven't been invited can't complete sign-in yet. From Q1 2027, ALICE will gradually open to Soundscape members.
defaultPrompt: List the Soundscape organizations I can access.
Show the latest real-time analytics summary for a specific organization.
Help me with a Soundscape workflow question.
